lines.t: # No Beginning
**Verse 1**
The morning light is breaking through
Painting gold across my room
And I think about how long You've been
Before the world, before all things
You were there before the stars
Before the light, before the dark.
And I could spend my whole life wondering
How You've always been
**Chorus**
You have always been
No beginning, no end
How could that be so?
I can't fully understand now
You are more than I can fathom
More than I know
And even when I can't explain You
I will trust You as I go
You have always been
No beginning, no end
**Verse 2**
As I'm walking around, I'm wondering
Of all the mysteries of You
There's so much I don't know
But I do know You are true
I don't need all the answers
I'm content just with You
But I still find it amazing how...
**Chorus**
You have always been
No beginning, no end
How could that be so?
I can't fully understand now
But there's one thing that I know
You are more than I can fathom
More than I could ever know
And even when I can't explain You
I will trust You as I go
You have always been
No beginning, no end
**Bridge**
Before the earth, You were there
Before time had a name, You were there
You are here, right now with me
You have been for all eternity
And You will always be
You will always be
The God who was, the God who is
The God who always will be
Sun shining on my face
Your presence all around
I may never know it all
But in You, I'm safe and sound
And as the morning starts anew
I'll keep standing in the wonder of You
